channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Tech & Infrastructure, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Tech & Infrastructure, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 18 May 2026 (18 May to 24 May 2026).

  • Council of Europe: New Democratic Pact for Europe Democracy Hackathon 2026 (Strasbourg)
    Council of Europe (under the Monaco Presidency of the Committee of Ministers), in partnership with No Hate Speech Week and Microsoft · deadline Closed 05 Jun 2026 · EUR 50,000 Microsoft-funded prize pool distributed among winning teams. Travel and accommodation covered for the 20 selected finalist teams. No application fee.
